**Verdict: ready for the maintainer to merge.**

## What looks good

- The fix reads `rotAt` - the #885 model of "the angles the control holds", never reset elsewhere in the script. That is exactly the stale pose of #3466. The new function sets the held letters to zero after the move, so the model matches the control again.
- The pattern is the house pattern of #3421 and `tormach.cps`: retract to the reference height, then the zero angle words, then `xyUnknown` so the first X/Y traverse states its height again. The return sits in `startPreamble` after the `G90 ... G49 G80` line and before the tool change, so the same tool and a tool change get the same return.
- Doosan unclamps a turning A before the return and clamps after it, as `onRapid` does.
- The review checked the whole rotary-capable post set: Fanuc and Doosan now state the return; Tormach and Mach4 already did (Mach4 indexes the kinematic zeros when `hasTilted` is set, `assets/posts/mach4.cps` lines 585-625); every other shipped post refuses a posed or tilted record by name (`tiltOk`, `tiltRefused` or `refuse`). No silent stale-lean path is left in the shipped posts.
- The zero words are safe on a reversed lone X rotary: the dialect's own note says "A0 is the same word on either sign".
- An upright program stays byte for byte the same. The `fanuc_post` and `doosan_dnm_post` golden-law suites prove the body's claim "Goldens moved: none".
- The test file obeys the Testing law: every import comes from `camcraft-post`, its Gate map names that crate, and it has a provenance line. The pins were red before the fix (issue comment and body), and both scripts have mutation runs.
- `docs/decisions/3466-upright-after-tilt.md` records what was considered and dropped.
- Process files are untouched, so no `Process change:` line is needed. The body ends `Fixes #3466`, has the `Changelog:` line, and does not edit `CHANGELOG.md`. The commit subject is conventional.

## Results - merged with main, built locally

Run in the review worktree with `origin/main` (ce9d0d521) merged into the head. The trial merge is clean. Note: #3468 changed `assets/posts/fanuc.cps` after the author's base; the merge kept both sides, and the runs below exercised the combination. ## Heavy lanes

`cargo xtask gate heavy --base origin/main --dry-run` reaches 27 lanes (app heavy: `conformance`, `c_axis_live`, `mcp`, the lathe lanes, ...). The PR body records the author's green run of that command on this final head: "27 steps, 0 failed". The head matches and the reached-lane plan matches (27 steps). This review therefore relies on the author's run, and says so. This review did not run the heavy steps itself.

## Requested before merge

Nothing.

## Questions / notes (not blocking)

1. The body says "Stacked on #3421 (merge #3421 first)". #3421 merged into main today at 15:10 UTC, and the head's parent is its head. The diff against main is exactly the four files here. No action is needed; a merge planner reads this PR as ordinary.
2. Issue #3466 item 3 (the app refusal when a post script states no return) and item 4 (the Mach4 pin) are not in this PR; they are filed as #3477. `Fixes #3466` closes the issue when this merges. Until #3477 lands, a user-loaded post script can still post a stale lean without a refusal. The maintainer may want #3477 kept at P1 for that window.
3. One existing edge, not new here: with the `safeRetract` G53 option and a machine file without `safeRetractZ`, `retractHome` warns and writes nothing, so the return turns the rotaries with no written retract. `afterOp` has the same shape today. #3477's refusal check is the right place to harden it.

**Verdict: ready for the maintainer to merge.**

This review covers the new head `48c17f6c3` (before: `f9b38a9d7`). The three items of the open change request are done.

## What looks good

- The catalog golden changes only by six added lines, in two hunks: `G91 G28 Z0`, `G90`, `G00 A0.` in "Back pocket" and again in "Tilted pocket". No other line of `examples/catalog/multiaxis/indexed/indexed.nc` changes.
- The return between two tilted sections is kept by decision and is now pinned by `fanuc_returns_to_zero_between_two_tilted_sections` and `doosan_returns_to_zero_between_two_tilted_sections`. The decision record explains the choice and what it dropped.
- Both pin groups fail when the return is removed. I removed the `uprightAfterTilt()` call from each script and ran the pins. See the mutation result below.
- The safety order is correct. In `assets/posts/fanuc.cps:738-752` and `assets/posts/doosan-dnm.cps:793-807`, the function runs after the `G49` preamble line (`fanuc.cps:762`, `doosan-dnm.cps:819`). It retracts Z with `retractHome(false)` (`fanuc.cps:745`, `doosan-dnm.cps:800`) before it writes `G00 A0.` (`fanuc.cps:747`, `doosan-dnm.cps:804`). The zero block has no X or Y. `xyUnknown` is set, so the first X/Y traverse states its height again.
- The function fires only when a stated rotary in `rotAt` is away from zero. An upright program writes no return, and a test pins it.
- On Doosan, a turning A is unclamped before the return and clamped after it (`doosan-dnm.cps:803-805`). This matches `onRapid` (`doosan-dnm.cps:1028-1034`).
- The rules in AGENTS.md are met: the body ends `Fixes #3466` and has a `Changelog:` line. The decision record `docs/decisions/3466-upright-after-tilt.md` is in the PR. No process file, dependency, `CHANGELOG.md` or snapshot PNG changes. The test imports `camcraft_post`, sits in `crates/post/tests/`, and has a provenance line.

## Notes (not blocking)

- The `safeRetract` G53 branch is not pinned. If `safeRetract` is G53 and the machine file has no `safeRetractZ`, `retractHome` writes no retract and logs a warning, and the function then writes `G00 A0.`. The app blocks a post that has any warning (`crates/app/src/posting.rs:716`), so no unsafe output is produced through the app. A test of this branch would be a useful addition.
- The Doosan turning-A `M11`/`M10` ordering is correct by the read but is not pinned by a test. This PR uses a B tilt, so `turnsA` is false in the test. The PR body states this limit.
- Item 3 of #3466 (an app refusal for a user's post) and the Mach4 pin are deferred to #3477 (P3). The core wrong-output defect is fixed for the shipped posts and pinned. The maintainer may prefer `Refs #3466` instead of `Fixes #3466` while #3477 is open.
- No real control was exercised. The order is from the post text only.

Set `merge-ready` and removed `needs-rework` in one step (#3382). The review is clean on this head, the trial merge with `main` is clean, and GitHub reports `MERGEABLE`.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
